title: Go to Work
situation: The morning trip to work at the airport.
objective: Use go to work and go by to talk about your daily trip to the airport.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I go to work every morning.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I usually leave home early because I don't want to be late.
dialogue.indonesian: Biasanya saya berangkat dari rumah lebih awal karena tidak ingin terlambat.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Sometimes I go to work by car, and sometimes I go by motorcycle.
dialogue.indonesian: Terkadang saya pergi bekerja dengan mobil dan terkadang dengan sepeda motor.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Before I go to work, I usually have breakfast and drink a cup of coffee.
dialogue.indonesian: Sebelum berangkat kerja, saya biasanya sarapan dan minum secangkir kopi.

learningNotes: go to work memakai to karena work adalah tujuan: go to work, bukan go work.
Untuk transportasi, gunakan by + kendaraan tanpa a atau the: by car, by motorcycle.
Simple present dipakai untuk kebiasaan: I go, I usually leave, I have.
